quest.title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part II
quest.description: Cloud Retainer seems to want to use this "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to create a new dish...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000, Recipe: Rice Pudding x1

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One wonders if this device may make desserts also...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you making this time?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Impeccable timing, Traveler. One just finished ruminating on the making of this next dish — a "pudding," so it is named.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Much consultation did one have with the most recent and popular recipes before deciding on this dish. It is said to be soft and tasty — a fine dessert indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Changes and improvements, too, has one made to it...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: ...Along with the addition of rice.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Naturally, one's entitlement it is to name this new dish. Mmm... "Rice Pudding" shall its name be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds really filling...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The quality of the rice is key to this dish. Upon one's activation of the Supreme Cuisine Machine, order it one did to search for high-quality rice. The resulting search led one here.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well now, Traveler. Since you are presently here, will you help one collect some rice of fine stock? The Machine indicates that it may be found not far from here.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: This device needs tending, and one cannot be in two places at once.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Skilled you are in mind and hand, and are thus an invaluable helper. Go forth to one's aid, and one promises that you shall have a share in the Rice Pudding also.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Well then, one presumes upon your aid.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Traveler, one has now activated the machine. Follow the tracks it has created and retrieve the Rice that one desires.

talks.objective: Follow the aura trail and find the ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: Thank you! You saved my life... I'm Brunn, a merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: *sigh* Just my luck. I was originally transporting a batch of cargo...

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: But... I never expected to get attacked by monsters while I was on my way.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: I just kept running, I didn't have time to worry about the goods, or to tell which way I was going... Eventually, I ended up here.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: After I got here, I thought I had completely shaken them off. That's why I wanted to get out of the cart and check the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: But they suddenly came out of nowhere... Thank goodness for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of goods are you transporting?

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: I'm transporting a batch of ingredients, rice and stuff like that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this is the rice that the adeptus wanted us to find, but it doesn't look like there's much left...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you sell me some rice?

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: You want to buy rice? It's not that I don't want to sell it, it's just that...I basically lost all the goods in my cart on the road when I was running away.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: Those monsters must have brought the goods as loot back to their camp.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: What a headache. How can I get those goods back? If I can't get them back, I will lose a lot of money...

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: Traveler... I see that you are very skilled. Can you help me get those goods back?

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: I—If you are willing to help me, I will give you as much rice as you want!

response.speaker: Brunn
response.text: Thank you! I'm counting on you then!

response.speaker: Brunn
response.text: Bring my transport balloon along and place the goods on it.

response.speaker: Brunn
response.text: I'll leave it to you, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here. After you get the goods, please bring them back to me.

choices.text: I don't think I can carry so many goods...

response.speaker: Brunn
response.text: Don't worry, I have a solution.

talks.objective: Rescue the person surrounded by monsters

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: Did you bring the goods back? Thank you so much, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: You wanted... rice, right? Please wait a moment, I will pick rice of better quality for you...

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: There! This rice is for you, it should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. I should be on my way now.

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: I hope I don't meet any more monsters...

talks.objective: Seize the ingredients back and ensure the safety of the transport balloon

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well then. Is the Rice Pudding complete?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Mm, a lovely flavor indeed. No less would one expect of oneself, or one's own Supreme Cuisine Machine. Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's not get all high-strung here...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Your hand in this matter was mighty also, Traveler. Come. Prepared one has your recipe, as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: What then shall one cook next? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One could not call the heat control desirable...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: But no matter. One has ingredients to spare with which to attempt this once more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These should be the goods we're looking for. Wow, that's a lot of stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good thing we've got that transport balloon with us, huh? Come on, let's move this cargo back.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Are you fully prepared, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Indeed, this is most fine. Just the quality that one needs.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Since the ingredients are readied, one shall now activate the machine.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: As before, in your hands shall one leave the heat control, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One would have you report your readiness once you are sufficiently prepared.

talks.objective: Help Cloud Retainer complete the dish

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Then let us begin.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!

talks.objective: Help Cloud Retainer complete the dish

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmm. Ready yourself, then, and inform one once it is so.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Mm, a lovely flavor indeed. No less would one expect of oneself, or one's own Supreme Cuisine Machine. Haha!

choices.text: Let's not get all high-strung here...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Your hand in this matter was mighty also, Traveler. Come. Prepared one has your recipe, as promised.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: What then shall one cook next? Hmm...

choices.text: How can this machine seemingly do everything...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Cunning one's hands are, and no less should be expected of one's hand-crafted masterwork. Hardly a cause for alarm, one would say.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you secured the requisite Rice?

dialogues.speaker: Brunn
dialogues.text: I'll leave it to you, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here. After you get the goods, please bring them back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well then. Is the Rice Pudding complete?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve the requisite Rice.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One shall entrust the heat control to you, Traveler.
